author: BNK Invest
title: Dow Movers: BA, VZ
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Tuesday, shares of Verizon Communications ( VZ ) topped the list of the day's best performing Dow Jones Industrial Average components, trading up 0.4%. Year to date, Verizon Communications registers a 15.0% gain.
And the worst performing Dow component thus far on the day is Boeing ( BA ), trading down 3.9%. Boeing is showing a gain of 4.5% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Apple ( AAPL ), trading down 3.5%, and Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ ), trading up 0.4% on the day.
